en.name: Saint Bernard Converts a Duke with the Eucharist
en.summary: An excommunicated duke is said to have fallen to his knees when presented with the Blessed Sacrament by Saint Bernard of Clairvaux.
en.body: In 1134, Saint Bernard of Clairvaux is reported to have confronted the excommunicated William X, Duke of Aquitaine, at Chiaravalle by presenting him directly with the Blessed Sacrament; the duke reportedly collapsed to his knees in repentance.
